organization_type_check.name: organization_type_check
organization_type_check.value: (type = 'organization' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL) OR (type = 'personal' AND organization_id IS NULL)

memories_scope_target_check.name: memories_scope_target_check
memories_scope_target_check.value:
(
        ("memories"."scope" = 'organization' AND "memories"."chat_id" IS NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("memories"."scope" = 'chat' AND "memories"."chat_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("memories"."scope" = 'agent' AND "memories"."chat_id" IS NULL AND "memories"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )
